# ============================================================
# Lightning-Empire-AI-GTP4.1/frontend/main.py
# OPER 治理核心 + 3 AI 推理 (無內容持久化，無下載/打包)
# 版本：v5.0 (Data Boundary)
# ============================================================
import os
import json
import threading
import queue
import time
import hmac
import hashlib
import sqlite3
import logging
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Request, Header
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel
from github import Github, GithubException
from openai import OpenAI
from dotenv import load_dotenv
import uvicorn

# ============================================================
# 0. 環境與日誌
# ============================================================
load_dotenv()
os.makedirs('./logs', exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs('./data', exist_ok=True)

logging.basicConfig(
    filename='./logs/system.log',
    level=logging.INFO,
    format='%(asctime)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s'
)

# ---- 環境變數（僅 3 個真實 AI） ----
GITHUB_TOKEN = os.getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN")
OPENAI_API_KEY = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
XAI_API_KEY = os.getenv("XAI_API_KEY")
DEEPSEEK_API_KEY = os.getenv("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY")
WEBHOOK_SECRET = os.getenv("GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET", "")
ADMIN_API_KEY = os.getenv("ADMIN_API_KEY", "change-me")

OPENAI_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_MODEL", "gpt-4o")
XAI_MODEL = os.getenv("XAI_MODEL", "grok-1")
DEEPSEEK_MODEL = os.getenv("DEEPSEEK_MODEL", "deepseek-chat")

if not all([GITHUB_TOKEN, OPENAI_API_KEY, XAI_API_KEY, DEEPSEEK_API_KEY]):
    logging.error("缺少必要環境變數")
    print("❌ 請確認 .env 完整 (GITHUB_TOKEN, OPENAI_API_KEY, XAI_API_KEY, DEEPSEEK_API_KEY)")
    exit(1)

# ============================================================
# 1. SQLite – 僅儲存 Metadata（無內容）
# ============================================================
DB_PATH = os.getenv("DATABASE_PATH", "data/system.db")

def get_db():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return conn

def init_db():
    with get_db() as conn:
        conn.executescript("""
            PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;

            -- 任務控制記錄（不含內容）
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_history (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                task_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                source_org TEXT NOT NULL,
                repo_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                assigned_ai TEXT NOT NULL,
                action TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL,
                error_code TEXT,
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            );

            -- 審計記錄（僅事件類型，無內容）
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_log (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                task_id TEXT,
                action TEXT NOT NULL,
                repo_key TEXT,
                details TEXT,               -- 僅放非內容的簡短訊息，如 "permission_denied"
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            );

            -- Token 用量紀錄（數值，無內容）
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS usage_log (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                ai_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                prompt_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                completion_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            );

            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_task_status ON task_history(status);
            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_created ON audit_log(created_at);
        """)
        logging.info("Metadata 資料庫初始化完成 (無內容儲存)")
init_db()

# ============================================================
# 2. Pydantic 模型
# ============================================================
class Task(BaseModel):
    task_id: str
    source_org: str
    repo_name: str
    action: str  # "read" or "write"
    assigned_ai: str  # "openai", "xai", "deepseek", "oper"
    content: Optional[str] = None   # 僅用作暫存指令，不儲存
    branch: str = "main"
    status: str = "pending"

class ChatContextRequest(BaseModel):
    session_id: str
    role: str
    content: str
    project: str = "Lightning-AI-ALL"

class OperCommandRequest(BaseModel):
    session_id: str
    project: str = "Lightning-AI-ALL"
    instruction: str

# ============================================================
# 3. OPER 核心：權限矩陣 + 安全政策 (Data Boundary)
# ============================================================
PERMISSION_MATRIX = {
    "openai": {
        "Lightning-Ai-ALL": {"read": True, "write": "auto"},
        "Stormcar820": {"read": False, "write": None}
    },
    "xai": {
        "Lightning-Ai-ALL": {"read": False, "write": None},
        "Stormcar820": {"read": True, "write": "manual"}
    },
    "deepseek": {
        "Lightning-Ai-ALL": {"read": False, "write": None},
        "Stormcar820": {"read": True, "write": "manual"}
    },
    "oper": {
        "Lightning-Ai-ALL": {"read": True, "write": None},
        "Stormcar820": {"read": True, "write": None}
    }
}

DATA_BOUNDARY_POLICY = {
    "allow_context_use": True,
    "context_mode": "ephemeral",          # 僅在任務期間保留於記憶體
    "clear_context_after_task": True,

    "deny_download": True,
    "deny_zip": True,
    "deny_archive": True,
    "deny_git_bundle": True,
    "deny_git_export": True,
    "deny_clone_export": True,
    "deny_external_upload": True,
    "deny_copy_out": True,

    "persist_chat_content": False,
    "persist_full_context": False,
    "persist_full_prompt": False,
    "persist_full_ai_response": False,
    "persist_repo_content": False,
    "persist_downloaded_files": False,

    "allow_metadata_audit": True,
    "allow_task_status": True,
    "allow_error_code": True,
    "allow_permission_result": True,

    "repo_write_requires_approval": True,
    "safe_mode_on_violation": True,
}

def check_permission(ai_name: str, org: str, action: str):
    ai_rules = PERMISSION_MATRIX.get(ai_name, {})
    org_rules = ai_rules.get(org, {})
    if action == "read":
        return org_rules.get("read", False), None
    elif action == "write":
        mode = org_rules.get("write")
        if mode is None:
            return False, None
        return True, mode
    return False, None

def enforce_data_boundary():
    """檢查是否有違反邊界政策的行為，此處僅做標記，實際在 API 層強制拒絕"""
    # 此函數作為政策標示，不執行實際邏輯
    pass

# ============================================================
# 4. Repository Registry (動態去重，僅讀取 metadata)
# ============================================================
class RepositoryRegistry:
    def __init__(self):
        self.repo_map: Dict[str, dict] = {}
        self.gmail_scope_keys: List[str] = []
        self.shared_scope_keys: List[str] = []
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._initialized = False

    def fetch_all_repos(self):
        if self._initialized:
            return self.repo_map
        print("🔄 OPER 正在動態讀取 GitHub 組織...")
        g = Github(GITHUB_TOKEN)
        for org_name, scope in [("Lightning-Ai-ALL", "gmail"), ("Stormcar820", "shared")]:
            try:
                org = g.get_organization(org_name)
                count = 0
                for repo in org.get_repos():
                    key = f"{org_name}/{repo.name}"
                    if key not in self.repo_map:
                        self.repo_map[key] = {
                            "org": org_name,
                            "name": repo.name,
                            "private": repo.private,
                            "full_name": repo.full_name,
                            "scope": scope
                        }
                        if scope == "gmail":
                            self.gmail_scope_keys.append(key)
                        else:
                            self.shared_scope_keys.append(key)
                        count += 1
                print(f"✅ [{org_name}] 註冊 {count} 個唯一庫")
            except GithubException as e:
                print(f"❌ 無法讀取 {org_name}：{e}")
        self._initialized = True
        print(f"🎯 OPER 總計註冊唯一庫: {len(self.repo_map)}")
        return self.repo_map

    def is_repo_allowed(self, org, repo_name):
        return f"{org}/{repo_name}" in self.repo_map

    def get_repo_info(self, org, repo_name):
        return self.repo_map.get(f"{org}/{repo_name}")

    def get_stats(self):
        return {
            "total_unique": len(self.repo_map),
            "gmail_scope_count": len(self.gmail_scope_keys),
            "shared_scope_count": len(self.shared_scope_keys),
        }

# ============================================================
# 5. 佇列與核准管理（無內容儲存）
# ============================================================
class QueueManager:
    def __init__(self):
        self.task_queue = queue.Queue()
        self.approval_tasks: Dict[str, Task] = {}
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self.db = get_db()

    def submit_task(self, task: Task):
        # 僅儲存 metadata，不儲存 content
        with self.db as conn:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO task_history (task_id, source_org, repo_name, assigned_ai, action, status) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                (task.task_id, task.source_org, task.repo_name, task.assigned_ai, task.action, task.status)
            )
        self.task_queue.put(task)

    def submit_for_approval(self, task: Task):
        task.status = "awaiting_approval"
        with self.db as conn:
            conn.execute("UPDATE task_history SET status=?, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id=?", (task.status, task.task_id))
            conn.execute("INSERT INTO audit_log (task_id, action, repo_key, details) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                         (task.task_id, "write_request", f"{task.source_org}/{task.repo_name}", "等待人工核准"))
        with self._lock:
            self.approval_tasks[task.task_id] = task

    def approve_task(self, task_id: str):
        with self._lock:
            task = self.approval_tasks.pop(task_id, None)
        if task:
            task.status = "approved"
            with self.db as conn:
                conn.execute("UPDATE task_history SET status=?, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id=?", (task.status, task.task_id))
                conn.execute("INSERT INTO audit_log (task_id, action, repo_key, details) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                             (task.task_id, "approved", f"{task.source_org}/{task.repo_name}", "已人工核准"))
            self.task_queue.put(task)
        return task

    def get_pending_approvals(self):
        with self._lock:
            return list(self.approval_tasks.values())
    def get_queue_size(self):
        return self.task_queue.qsize()
    def get_approval_count(self):
        with self._lock:
            return len(self.approval_tasks)

# ============================================================
# 6. 臨時上下文管理（記憶體，任務結束即清除）
# ============================================================
class EphemeralContext:
    """僅保存於記憶體，任務完成或逾時自動清除"""
    def __init__(self):
        self._contexts: Dict[str, Dict] = {}  # task_id -> context_data
        self._lock = threading.RLock()

    def set_context(self, task_id: str, data: dict):
        with self._lock:
            self._contexts[task_id] = data

    def get_context(self, task_id: str):
        with self._lock:
            return self._contexts.get(task_id)

    def clear_context(self, task_id: str):
        with self._lock:
            if task_id in self._contexts:
                del self._contexts[task_id]

    def clear_all(self):
        with self._lock:
            self._contexts.clear()

ephemeral_context = EphemeralContext()

# ============================================================
# 7. 3 個推理 AI 客戶端（不保存內容）
# ============================================================
class OpenAIClient:
    def __init__(self):
        self.client = OpenAI(api_key=OPENAI_API_KEY)
        self.model = OPENAI_MODEL
    def analyze(self, content):
        return self.client.chat.completions.create(model=self.model, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": content}])

class XAIClient:
    def __init__(self):
        self.client = OpenAI(api_key=XAI_API_KEY, base_url="https://api.x.ai/v1")
        self.model = XAI_MODEL
    def analyze(self, content):
        return self.client.chat.completions.create(model=self.model, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": content}])

class DeepSeekClient:
    def __init__(self):
        self.client = OpenAI(api_key=DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, base_url="https://api.deepseek.com/v1")
        self.model = DEEPSEEK_MODEL
    def analyze(self, content):
        return self.client.chat.completions.create(model=self.model, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": content}])

class OperAIClient:
    """OPER 本地監控節點 (無外部 API)"""
    def analyze(self, stats: dict):
        return {"type": "oper_local_monitor", "status": "READY", "mode": "LOCAL", "external_api": False, "stats": stats}

    def generate_dashboard_insights(self, stats: dict, pending_tasks: list, recent_audit: list) -> dict:
        return {
            "status": "READY",
            "mode": "LOCAL",
            "external_api": False,
            "total_repos": stats.get("total_unique", 0),
            "queue_size": stats.get("queue_size", 0),
            "approval_count": stats.get("approval_count", 0),
            "audit_count": len(recent_audit),
            "pending_tasks": [t.get("task_id") for t in pending_tasks[:5]]
        }

# ============================================================
# 8. OPER Worker（執行任務，禁止下載/打包）
# ============================================================
def production_worker(registry: RepositoryRegistry, queue_manager: QueueManager):
    print("⚙️ OPER Worker 啟動 (3 AI 推理 + OPER 監控)")
    g = Github(GITHUB_TOKEN)
    ai_clients = {
        "openai": OpenAIClient(),
        "xai": XAIClient(),
        "deepseek": DeepSeekClient(),
        "oper": OperAIClient(),
    }
    db = get_db()

    while True:
        task = None
        try:
            task = queue_manager.task_queue.get(timeout=3)
            if task is None:
                break

            repo_key = f"{task.source_org}/{task.repo_name}"
            repo_info = registry.get_repo_info(task.source_org, task.repo_name)
            if not repo_info:
                logging.warning(f"❌ OPER: 庫 {repo_key} 不在註冊表")
                task.status = "failed"
                with db as conn:
                    conn.execute("UPDATE task_history SET status=? WHERE task_id=?", (task.status, task.task_id))
                continue

            # 權限檢查
            allowed, write_mode = check_permission(task.assigned_ai, task.source_org, task.action)
            if not allowed:
                logging.error(f"❌ OPER 拒絕: {task.assigned_ai} 在 {task.source_org} 執行 {task.action}")
                task.status = "failed"
                with db as conn:
                    conn.execute("UPDATE task_history SET status=? WHERE task_id=?", (task.status, task.task_id))
                    conn.execute("INSERT INTO audit_log (task_id, action, repo_key, details) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                                 (task.task_id, "permission_denied", repo_key, f"{task.assigned_ai} 無權限"))
                continue

            # 寫入需人工核准
            if task.action == "write" and write_mode == "manual":
                queue_manager.submit_for_approval(task)
                print(f"⏸️ OPER 送審: {repo_key} 寫入需人工核准")
                continue

            # ----- 讀取任務（僅讀取檔案列表，不下載內容） -----
            if task.action == "read":
                repo = g.get_repo(repo_info["full_name"])
                # 僅取得根目錄檔案列表（不下載檔案內容）
                contents = repo.get_contents("")
                file_list = [c.path for c in contents[:20]]  # 僅取前20個路徑，不載入內容
                # 建立最小上下文（不含完整內容）
                minimal_context = {
                    "repo": repo_key,
                    "file_count": len(contents),
                    "sample_files": file_list,
                    "instruction": task.content[:200] if task.content else ""  # 僅取前200字
                }
                # 存入臨時記憶體（任務完成後清除）
                ephemeral_context.set_context(task.task_id, minimal_context)

                ai_client = ai_clients.get(task.assigned_ai)
                if ai_client:
                    # 發送最小上下文給 AI（不發送完整 repo 內容）
                    prompt = f"請根據以下資訊進行分析：\n{json.dumps(minimal_context, ensure_ascii=False)}"
                    if task.assigned_ai == "oper":
                        # OPER 本地監控，不呼叫外部 API
                        stats = registry.get_stats()
                        stats["queue_size"] = queue_manager.get_queue_size()
                        stats["approval_count"] = queue_manager.get_approval_count()
                        pending = queue_manager.get_pending_approvals()
                        with db as conn:
                            audit = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM audit_log ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20").fetchall()
                        insights = ai_client.generate_dashboard_insights(
                            stats=stats,
                            pending_tasks=[{"task_id": t.task_id} for t in pending],
                            recent_audit=[dict(row) for row in audit]
                        )
                        # 僅儲存結果摘要（不儲存完整內容）
                        task.ai_response = json.dumps(insights, ensure_ascii=False)[:500]  # 截斷
                    else:
                        response = ai_client.analyze(prompt)
                        if hasattr(response, 'usage'):
                            with db as conn:
                                conn.execute(
                                    "INSERT INTO usage_log (task_id, ai_name, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)",
                                    (task.task_id, task.assigned_ai, response.usage.prompt_tokens, response.usage.completion_tokens, response.usage.total_tokens)
                                )
                        # 僅儲存回答的前 500 字作為摘要（非完整內容）
                        task.ai_response = response.choices[0].message.content[:500] if response.choices else ""
                task.status = "done"
                with db as conn:
                    conn.execute("UPDATE task_history SET status=?, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id=?", (task.status, task.task_id))
                print(f"📖 {task.assigned_ai} 完成讀取 {repo_key}")
                # 清除臨時上下文
                ephemeral_context.clear_context(task.task_id)

            # ----- 寫入任務（僅當核准後） -----
            elif task.action == "write" and task.status == "approved":
                repo = g.get_repo(repo_info["full_name"])
                # 只寫入 metadata 摘要，不寫入大量內容
                file_path = f"ai_outputs/{task.task_id}.txt"
                # 內容限縮為簡短摘要（不允許寫入原始內容）
                safe_content = f"任務 {task.task_id} 結果摘要 (僅 metadata):\n{task.content[:200] if task.content else ''}"
                repo.create_file(file_path, f"AI 生成摘要: {task.task_id}", safe_content, branch=task.branch)
                task.status = "done"
                with db as conn:
                    conn.execute("UPDATE task_history SET status=? WHERE task_id=?", (task.status, task.task_id))
                    conn.execute("INSERT INTO audit_log (task_id, action, repo_key, details) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                                 (task.task_id, "write_executed", repo_key, f"已寫入 {file_path} (摘要)"))
                print(f"✍️ {task.assigned_ai} 成功寫入摘要 {repo_key}")

        except queue.Empty:
            continue
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"⚠️ OPER Worker 錯誤: {e}")
            if task:
                task.status = "failed"
                with db as conn:
                    conn.execute("UPDATE task_history SET status=? WHERE task_id=?", (task.status, task.task_id))
                    # 僅記錄錯誤代碼，不記錄詳細內容
                    conn.execute("INSERT INTO audit_log (task_id, action, repo_key, details) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                                 (task.task_id, "error", repo_key, f"錯誤碼: {type(e).__name__}"))
        finally:
            if task is not None:
                queue_manager.task_queue.task_done()
                # 確保上下文被清除（若因例外未清除）
                ephemeral_context.clear_context(task.task_id)

# ============================================================
# 9. FastAPI 應用（無下載/打包端點）
# ============================================================
app = FastAPI(title="Lightning-Empire-AI-GTP4.1 Frontend", version="5.0")
registry = RepositoryRegistry()
queue_manager = QueueManager()

@app.on_event("startup")
def startup():
    print("\n" + "="*50)
    print("⚡ 啟動 Lightning-Empire-AI-GTP4.1 Frontend (Data Boundary)")
    print("="*50)
    registry.fetch_all_repos()
    app.state.registry = registry
    app.state.queue_manager = queue_manager
    threading.Thread(target=production_worker, args=(registry, queue_manager), daemon=True).start()
    stats = registry.get_stats()
    print(f"✅ OPER 就緒 | 總庫: {stats['total_unique']} | OpenAI: {stats['gmail_scope_count']} | 共享: {stats['shared_scope_count']}")
    print("🔒 寫入 Stormcar820 強制人工核准")
    print("📊 OPER 本地監控節點已上線 (無外部 API)")
    print("🚫 資料邊界政策生效：禁止下載/打包/持久化內容")
    print("="*50 + "\n")

# ============================================================
# 10. API 端點（不提供任何下載/打包功能）
# ============================================================

@app.get("/")
async def dashboard():

    <div class="grid">
        <div class="card"><h3>📋 佇列</h3><span id="queueSize">0</span></div>
        <div class="card"><h3>⏸️ 待審</h3><span id="approvalSize">0</span></div>
        <div class="card"><h3>📦 總庫</h3><span id="totalRepos">-</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card"><h3>📤 派工</h3>
        <input id="taskId" placeholder="TASK-001">
        <select id="orgSelect"><option>Lightning-Ai-ALL</option><option>Stormcar820</option></select>
        <input id="repoName" placeholder="repo">
        <select id="aiSelect"><option>openai</option><option>xai</option><option>deepseek</option><option>oper</option></select>
        <select id="actionSelect"><option>read</option><option>write</option></select>
        <button onclick="submitTask()">派工</button>
    </div>
    <div class="card"><h3>⏸️ 待審清單</h3><div id="approvalList">無</div></div>
    <div class="card"><h3>📜 歷史</h3><div id="historyLog"></div></div>
    <div class="card"><h3>📊 OPER 洞察</h3><div id="operInsights">載入中...</div></div>
    <script>
        async function fetchStatus() {
            const res = await fetch('/api/status');
            const data = await res.json();
            document.getElementById('totalRepos').innerText = data.total_unique || 0;
            document.getElementById('gmailCount').innerText = data.gmail_scope_count || 0;
            document.getElementById('xaiCount').innerText = data.shared_scope_count || 0;
            document.getElementById('dsCount').innerText = data.shared_scope_count || 0;
            document.getElementById('queueSize').innerText = data.queue_size || 0;
            document.getElementById('approvalSize').innerText = data.approval_count || 0;
            let html = '';
            if(data.pending_approvals) data.pending_approvals.forEach(t=>{html+=`<div><b>${t.task_id}</b> ${t.repo_name} <button onclick="approve('${t.task_id}')">✅核准</button></div>`;});
            document.getElementById('approvalList').innerHTML = html || '無';
            let hist = '';
            if(data.recent_history) data.recent_history.slice(0,5).forEach(t=>{hist+=`<div>${t.status}|${t.task_id}|${t.assigned_ai}</div>`;});
            document.getElementById('historyLog').innerHTML = hist;
            const operRes = await fetch('/api/oper/insights');
            const operData = await operRes.json();
            document.getElementById('operInsights').innerHTML = `<pre>${JSON.stringify(operData, null, 2)}</pre>`;
        }
        async function submitTask() {
            const payload = {
                task_id: document.getElementById('taskId').value || 'TASK-'+Date.now(),
                source_org: document.getElementById('orgSelect').value,
                repo_name: document.getElementById('repoName').value,
                assigned_ai: document.getElementById('aiSelect').value,
                action: document.getElementById('actionSelect').value,
                content: 'OPER 調度 (無內容儲存)'
            };
            const res = await fetch('/submit_task', {method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(payload)});
            alert((await res.json()).message);
            fetchStatus();
        }
        async function approve(taskId) {
            if(!confirm(`核准 ${taskId}?`)) return;
            const res = await fetch(`/approve/${taskId}`, {method:'POST', headers: {'X-Admin-Key': prompt('請輸入管理金鑰:')}});
            alert((await res.json()).message);
            fetchStatus();
        }
        fetchStatus();
        setInterval(fetchStatus, 5000);
    </script>
    </body>
    </html>
    """)

@app.get("/api/status")
async def status():
    stats = registry.get_stats()
    pending = queue_manager.get_pending_approvals()
    with get_db() as conn:
        history = conn.execute("SELECT task_id, status, assigned_ai, action, repo_name FROM task_history ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10").fetchall()
    return {
        **stats,
        "queue_size": queue_manager.get_queue_size(),
        "approval_count": queue_manager.get_approval_count(),
        "pending_approvals": [{"task_id": t.task_id, "repo_name": t.repo_name} for t in pending],
        "recent_history": [dict(row) for row in history]
    }

@app.get("/api/oper/insights")
async def oper_insights():
    stats = registry.get_stats()
    stats["queue_size"] = queue_manager.get_queue_size()
    stats["approval_count"] = queue_manager.get_approval_count()
    pending = queue_manager.get_pending_approvals()
    with get_db() as conn:
        audit = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM audit_log ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20").fetchall()
    oper = OperAIClient()
    insights = oper.generate_dashboard_insights(
        stats=stats,
        pending_tasks=[{"task_id": t.task_id} for t in pending],
        recent_audit=[dict(row) for row in audit]
    )
    return insights

@app.post("/api/oper/context")
async def add_oper_context(data: ChatContextRequest):
    """接收上下文，僅暫存於記憶體，不寫入資料庫"""
    # 將上下文存入 ephemeral 記憶體（使用 session_id 作為 key）
    context_key = f"session_{data.session_id}"
    ephemeral_context.set_context(context_key, {
        "role": data.role,
        "content": data.content[:500],  # 僅保留前500字為最小上下文
        "project": data.project,
        "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()
    })
    # 不寫入任何資料庫
    return {"status": "context_received_ephemeral", "session_id": data.session_id}

@app.post("/api/oper/command")
async def oper_command(data: OperCommandRequest):
    """OPER 指揮：使用暫存上下文，派發任務，完成後清除上下文"""
    # 從 ephemeral 讀取上下文（若存在）
    context_key = f"session_{data.session_id}"
    ctx = ephemeral_context.get_context(context_key)
    if ctx:
        instruction_with_context = f"{data.instruction}\n\n上下文: {ctx.get('content', '')}"
    else:
        instruction_with_context = data.instruction

    # 建立任務
    command_id = f"OPER-{int(time.time() * 1000)}"
    tasks = []
    for ai_name in ["openai", "xai", "deepseek"]:
        if ai_name == "openai":
            org, repo = "Lightning-Ai-ALL", "Lightning-AI-ALL"
        else:
            org, repo = "Stormcar820", "Lightning-Empire-AI-GTP4.1"
        task = Task(
            task_id=f"{command_id}-{ai_name.upper()}",
            source_org=org,
            repo_name=repo,
            action="read",
            assigned_ai=ai_name,
            content=instruction_with_context[:500]  # 僅傳遞必要資訊
        )
        queue_manager.submit_task(task)
        tasks.append(task.task_id)

    # 任務派送後清除該 session 的暫存上下文（只在這裡清除，worker 完成後也會清除）
    ephemeral_context.clear_context(context_key)

    return {
        "status": "dispatched",
        "command_id": command_id,
        "tasks": tasks,
        "assigned": ["openai", "xai", "deepseek"],
        "context_used": bool(ctx)
    }

@app.post("/submit_task")
async def submit_task(task: Task):
    if not registry.is_repo_allowed(task.source_org, task.repo_name):
        raise HTTPException(404, "Repository 不在註冊表")
    allowed, _ = check_permission(task.assigned_ai, task.source_org, task.action)
    if not allowed:
        raise HTTPException(403, f"{task.assigned_ai} 無權限")
    if task.action == "write":
        _, mode = check_permission(task.assigned_ai, task.source_org, "write")
        if mode == "manual":
            queue_manager.submit_for_approval(task)
            return {"message": f"任務 {task.task_id} 已送審 (需人工核准)"}
    queue_manager.submit_task(task)
    return {"message": f"任務 {task.task_id} 已派發給 {task.assigned_ai}"}

@app.post("/approve/{task_id}")
async def approve_task(task_id: str, admin_key: str = Header(..., alias="X-Admin-Key")):
    if admin_key != ADMIN_API_KEY:
        raise HTTPException(401, "無效管理金鑰")
    task = queue_manager.approve_task(task_id)
    if not task:
        raise HTTPException(404, "找不到該任務")
    return {"message": f"✅ 任務 {task_id} 已核准"}

@app.post("/webhook/github")
async def webhook(request: Request, x_hub_signature_256: str = Header(None)):
    body = await request.body()
    if WEBHOOK_SECRET:
        expected = "sha256=" + hmac.new(WEBHOOK_SECRET.encode(), body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
        if not hmac.compare_digest(expected, x_hub_signature_256 or ""):
            raise HTTPException(401, "Invalid signature")
    payload = await request.json()
    repo_name = payload.get("repository", {}).get("name")
    org_name = payload.get("organization", {}).get("login")
    if repo_name and org_name:
        task = Task(
            task_id=f"wh-{int(time.time())}",
            source_org=org_name,
            repo_name=repo_name,
            action="read",
            assigned_ai="deepseek" if org_name=="Stormcar820" else "openai",
            content="Webhook 觸發 (無內容儲存)"
        )
        queue_manager.submit_task(task)
        return {"message": f"Webhook 觸發 {task.task_id}"}
    return {"message": "ignored"}

# 強制禁止任何下載/打包的路由（如果存在，主動拒絕）
@app.get("/download")
@app.get("/zip")
@app.get("/archive")
@app.get("/git-bundle")
@app.get("/export")
async def deny_download():
    raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="下載/打包功能已被系統管理員禁用 (Data Boundary Policy)")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    uvicorn.run("main:app", host="0.0.0.0", port=8000, reload=False)對。這一版要再收緊：OPER AI 可以使用上下文，但應用程式本身不得把這些上下文保存成聊天紀錄或內容日誌。

🔒 OPER 最終資料規則

使用者上下文
                       │
                       ▼
                ⚡ OPER Context
                       │
             ┌─────────┴─────────┐
             │                   │
          可暫時使用            禁止持久化
             │                   │
             ▼                   ▼
       指揮 3 AI             不寫聊天內容
       任務判斷              不寫完整 Prompt
       安全判斷              不寫完整 AI Context
                              不寫下載檔案
                              不寫打包檔
                       │
                       ▼
                任務完成後釋放

🚫 明確禁止

OPER_DATA_POLICY = {
    "allow_context_use": True,

    # 資料外洩
    "allow_download": False,
    "allow_archive": False,
    "allow_zip": False,
    "allow_git_bundle": False,
    "allow_external_upload": False,
    "allow_external_transfer": False,

    # 應用程式資料保存
    "persist_chat_content": False,
    "persist_full_prompt": False,
    "persist_full_context": False,
    "persist_ai_response": False,
    "persist_downloaded_files": False,

    # 安全
    "read_only_monitoring": True,
    "repo_write_requires_approval": True,
}

最重要的區別

可以：

聊天上下文
   ↓
OPER 暫時放在記憶體
   ↓
建立本次任務 Context
   ↓
交給 3 AI 執行
   ↓
完成
   ↓
清除暫存 Context

不可以：

聊天
 ↓
SQLite
 ↓
完整永久紀錄

所以你前面要的 oper_context.py 不能再使用 chat_context / project_context 表來保存完整內容。那會違反你現在這條規則。

SQLite 只留下「非內容型」控制紀錄

例如可以保留：

command_id
時間
任務狀態
assigned_ai
success / failed
權限判定
安全規則命中
錯誤代碼

但不要保存：

❌ 使用者完整聊天內容
❌ 完整 AI Prompt
❌ 完整 Context
❌ Repo 打包內容
❌ 下載檔案
❌ AI 完整回答

因此最終定位就是：

> OPER 可以「看上下文、用上下文、指揮 3 AI」，但不把上下文變成應用程式的永久資料庫。



另外，禁止下載／打包應該是程式能力層面的 DENY，不只是寫在 Prompt 裡提醒 AI；這樣才是真正的安全邊界。Oper ai監控禁止下載，打包
可上下文但應用程式不能記錄可以。這條應該直接升級成 OPER Context 的資料外洩防護規則，而且要由 OPER 在派給 3 AI 前就注入上下文。

🔒 最終安全政策

DATA_EXFILTRATION_POLICY = {
    # 禁止建立／打包
    "deny_zip": True,
    "deny_archive": True,

    # 禁止 Git 資料外帶
    "deny_git_export": True,
    "deny_git_bundle": True,
    "deny_git_clone_export": True,

    # 禁止下載
    "deny_download": True,

    # 禁止把專案資料傳到外部位置
    "deny_external_upload": True,
    "deny_external_transfer": True,

    # 禁止未授權複製
    "deny_copy_out": True,

    # GitHub 寫入仍受既有權限矩陣控制
    "repo_write_requires_approval": True,

    # 異常狀態進入唯讀安全模式
    "safe_mode_on_violation": True,
}

OPER 派給 3 AI 時

OPER DATA SECURITY POLICY

禁止：
1. 建立 ZIP / RAR / 7z 或任何壓縮封裝
2. 匯出 Git repository
3. 建立 git bundle
4. Clone 到未授權位置
5. 下載專案資料
6. 上傳到外部服務
7. 將專案內容傳送至未授權目的地
8. 複製完整 Repo 到外部位置
9. 未經授權產生資料外洩通道

允許：
- 在授權範圍內讀取必要資料
- 產生分析結果
- 寫入 SQLite audit
- 顯示 Dashboard
- 依既有權限執行核准後的 Repo 操作

安全優先：
若任務要求違反上述規則，停止該任務並記錄 audit。

最重要的一點

這不是「禁止 GitHub」。

而是區分：

GitHub 授權讀取
       ↓
     允許
       ↓
AI 分析
       ↓
OPER Audit
       ↓
結果回系統


ZIP / Git Bundle / 未授權 Clone
       ↓
     DENY


下載／外部 Upload／外洩
       ↓
     DENY
       ↓
   Audit Log
       ↓
   Safe Mode

因此你目前的架構可以正式定義成：

> OPER Context = 專案上下文 + 安全政策 + 權限矩陣 + 3AI 指揮上下文。



而且不需要增加任何 Oper API、API Key 或外部服務。def build_ai_context(project_context, instruction):
    return {
        "project_context": project_context,

        "safety_policy": SAFETY_POLICY,

        "instruction": instruction,

        "rule": (
            "安全規則優先於一般任務。"
            "若偵測到異常聲音、明顯晃動或不確定狀態，"
            "不得因此觸發高風險、自動寫入或其他非必要動作。"
        )
    }SAFETY_POLICY = {
    "user_protection": True,

    # 不使用臉部辨識作為身分認證
    "face_identity_required": False,

    # 不因使用者聲音突然變大就執行危險操作
    "loud_voice_no_action": True,

    # 偵測到明顯晃動時，停止非必要自動動作
    "shake_event_no_action": True,

    # 異常狀態只允許觀測／記錄
    "safe_mode_on_anomaly": True,

    # 寫入 GitHub 仍然遵守既有人工核准
    "repo_write_requires_approval": True
}對，這樣就更準確了。你要的 OPER 不是第 4 個推理 AI，而是「專案上下文中樞＋指揮層」。

也就是：

👤 人類
                   │
             聊天／指令／需求
                   │
                   ▼
          ⚡ OPER Context Core
          ┌────────┼────────┐
          │        │        │
       建檔上下文  專案狀態  權限/治理
          │        │        │
          └────────┼────────┘
                   ▼
              OPER Router
          ┌────────┼────────┐
          ▼        ▼        ▼
       OpenAI     xAI    DeepSeek
          │        │        │
          └────────┼────────┘
                   ▼
             結果回 OPER
                   │
                   ▼
             SQLite / Dashboard

關鍵修正

你目前的 main.py 有：

RepositoryRegistry

QueueManager

PERMISSION_MATRIX

task_history

audit_log

usage_log


但還缺一層「聊天上下文 → 專案上下文 → AI 任務」。

而且有一個工程上的界線要講清楚：

> main.py 不會自動看到 ChatGPT 這個對話視窗裡的全部上下文。



必須由你的 UI／API 把對話內容送進 OPER。之後 OPER 才能把它建檔、整理，再指揮 3 AI。


---

⚡ 建議直接新增 oper_context.py

這個模組專門負責：

1. 保存聊天上下文


2. 保存專案上下文


3. 建立「本次指揮簡報」


4. 把簡報送給 3 AI


5. 統一收回結果


6. 寫入 SQLite



# ============================================================
# oper_context.py
# OPER Context Core
#
# Chat Context
#      ↓
# Project Context
#      ↓
# OPER Command Brief
#      ↓
# OpenAI / xAI / DeepSeek
#      ↓
# Result Ledger
#
# OPER 本身不做外部推理
# ============================================================

import json
import sqlite3
import time
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional


class OperContextCore:

    def __init__(self, db_path: str):
        self.db_path = db_path
        self.init_db()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # DB
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def db(self):
        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        return conn

    def init_db(self):

        with self.db() as conn:

            conn.executescript("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_context (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    role TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content TEXT NOT NULL,
                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                );

                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_context (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    project TEXT NOT NULL,
                    context_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content TEXT NOT NULL,
                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                );

                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oper_commands (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    command_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                    session_id TEXT,
                    instruction TEXT NOT NULL,
                    context_snapshot TEXT,
                    status TEXT NOT NULL,
                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                );

                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_results (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    command_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    ai_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    result TEXT,
                    status TEXT NOT NULL,
                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                );
            """)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 聊天建檔
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def add_chat(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        role: str,
        content: str
    ):

        with self.db() as conn:

            conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO chat_context
                (session_id, role, content)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?)
                """,
                (
                    session_id,
                    role,
                    content
                )
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 專案上下文
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def add_project_context(
        self,
        project: str,
        context_type: str,
        content: str
    ):

        with self.db() as conn:

            conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO project_context
                (project, context_type, content)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?)
                """,
                (
                    project,
                    context_type,
                    content
                )
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 取得最近聊天
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def get_chat_context(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        limit: int = 30
    ):

        with self.db() as conn:

            rows = conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT role, content, created_at
                FROM chat_context
                WHERE session_id=?
                ORDER BY id DESC
                LIMIT ?
                """,
                (
                    session_id,
                    limit
                )
            ).fetchall()

        rows = list(reversed(rows))

        return [
            {
                "role": row["role"],
                "content": row["content"],
                "created_at": row["created_at"]
            }
            for row in rows
        ]

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 取得專案上下文
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def get_project_context(
        self,
        project: str,
        limit: int = 50
    ):

        with self.db() as conn:

            rows = conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT context_type, content, created_at
                FROM project_context
                WHERE project=?
                ORDER BY id DESC
                LIMIT ?
                """,
                (
                    project,
                    limit
                )
            ).fetchall()

        return [
            {
                "type": row["context_type"],
                "content": row["content"],
                "created_at": row["created_at"]
            }
            for row in rows
        ]

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 建立 OPER 指揮簡報
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def build_command_brief(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        project: str,
        instruction: str
    ):

        chat = self.get_chat_context(session_id)

        project_context = self.get_project_context(project)

        brief = {
            "project": project,

            "instruction": instruction,

            "chat_context": chat,

            "project_context": project_context,

            "rules": {
                "oper_role": "governance_and_routing",
                "external_ai": [
                    "openai",
                    "xai",
                    "deepseek"
                ],
                "oper_external_api": False,
                "write_requires_existing_permission": True
            },

            "generated_at": datetime.now().isoformat()
        }

        return brief

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 建立指揮命令
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def create_command(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        project: str,
        instruction: str
    ):

        command_id = (
            f"OPER-{int(time.time() * 1000)}"
        )

        brief = self.build_command_brief(
            session_id=session_id,
            project=project,
            instruction=instruction
        )

        with self.db() as conn:

            conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO oper_commands
                (
                    command_id,
                    session_id,
                    instruction,
                    context_snapshot,
                    status
                )
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                """,
                (
                    command_id,
                    session_id,
                    instruction,
                    json.dumps(
                        brief,
                        ensure_ascii=False
                    ),
                    "queued"
                )
            )

        return {
            "command_id": command_id,
            "brief": brief
        }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # AI 結果
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def save_ai_result(
        self,
        command_id: str,
        ai_name: str,
        result: str,
        status: str = "done"
    ):

        with self.db() as conn:

            conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO ai_results
                (
                    command_id,
                    ai_name,
                    result,
                    status
                )
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
                """,
                (
                    command_id,
                    ai_name,
                    result,
                    status
                )
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 查看一次完整指揮
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def get_command(self, command_id: str):

        with self.db() as conn:

            command = conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT *
                FROM oper_commands
                WHERE command_id=?
                """,
                (command_id,)
            ).fetchone()

            results = conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT ai_name, result, status, created_at
                FROM ai_results
                WHERE command_id=?
                ORDER BY id
                """,
                (command_id,)
            ).fetchall()

        if not command:
            return None

        return {
            "command": dict(command),
            "ai_results": [
                dict(row)
                for row in results
            ]
        }

from oper_context import OperContextCore

建立：

oper_context = OperContextCore(DB_PATH)

然後加入兩個核心 API。

① 把聊天送進 OPER

class ChatContextRequest(BaseModel):
    session_id: str
    role: str
    content: str
    project: str = "Lightning-AI-ALL"


@app.post("/api/oper/context")
async def add_oper_context(data: ChatContextRequest):

    oper_context.add_chat(
        session_id=data.session_id,
        role=data.role,
        content=data.content
    )

    oper_context.add_project_context(
        project=data.project,
        context_type="chat",
        content=data.content
    )

    return {
        "status": "stored",
        "session_id": data.session_id,
        "project": data.project
    }

這樣你的前端每收到一段：

使用者：
今天把 3AI 自動化派單系統整理好。
OPER 看專案上下文。
OpenAI、xAI、DeepSeek 執行分析。

就可以送：

{
  "session_id": "main-session",
  "role": "user",
  "content": "今天把 3AI 自動化派單系統整理好。OPER 看專案上下文。OpenAI、xAI、DeepSeek 執行分析。",
  "project": "Lightning-AI-ALL"
}

② OPER 接到指令後指揮 3 AI

class OperCommandRequest(BaseModel):
    session_id: str
    project: str = "Lightning-AI-ALL"
    instruction: str


@app.post("/api/oper/command")
async def oper_command(data: OperCommandRequest):

    command = oper_context.create_command(
        session_id=data.session_id,
        project=data.project,
        instruction=data.instruction
    )

    brief = json.dumps(
        command["brief"],
        ensure_ascii=False
    )

    tasks = []

    # --------------------------------------------
    # OpenAI
    # --------------------------------------------

    openai_task = Task(
        task_id=f"{command['command_id']}-OPENAI",
        source_org="Lightning-Ai-ALL",
        repo_name="Lightning-AI-ALL",
        action="read",
        assigned_ai="openai",
        content=brief
    )

    queue_manager.submit_task(openai_task)
    tasks.append(openai_task.task_id)

    # --------------------------------------------
    # xAI
    # --------------------------------------------

    xai_task = Task(
        task_id=f"{command['command_id']}-XAI",
        source_org="Stormcar820",
        repo_name="Lightning-Empire-AI-GPT4.1",
        action="read",
        assigned_ai="xai",
        content=brief
    )

    queue_manager.submit_task(xai_task)
    tasks.append(xai_task.task_id)

    # --------------------------------------------
    # DeepSeek
    # --------------------------------------------

    deepseek_task = Task(
        task_id=f"{command['command_id']}-DEEPSEEK",
        source_org="Stormcar820",
        repo_name="Lightning-Empire-DeepSeek-全",
        action="read",
        assigned_ai="deepseek",
        content=brief
    )

    queue_manager.submit_task(deepseek_task)
    tasks.append(deepseek_task.task_id)

    return {
        "status": "dispatched",
        "command_id": command["command_id"],
        "tasks": tasks,
        "assigned": [
            "openai",
            "xai",
            "deepseek"
        ]
    }

不過這裡有一個重要工程修正：不要把 Repo 名稱硬寫死。

你目前已經有 RepositoryRegistry，所以實際版本應該讓 OPER 從 Registry 找符合權限的庫，再派任務。否則 GitHub 改名時就會壞。

🧠 最終工作流

你以後只需要對 OPER 下：

OPER：

查看目前 Lightning-AI-ALL 專案上下文。

今天的工作：
1. 檢查 3AI 自動化派單狀態
2. 看 78 庫目前有哪些異常
3. 讓 OpenAI 做架構分析
4. 讓 xAI 做交叉驗證
5. 讓 DeepSeek 做中文整理
6. 回收三方結果
7. 整理成一份決策摘要

OPER 做：

聊天上下文
      ↓
SQLite 建檔
      ↓
專案上下文
      ↓
Repository Registry
      ↓
Permission Matrix
      ↓
建立 OPER Command
      ↓
┌───────────────┐
│ 3 AI Dispatch │
└───────────────┘
      ↓
 ┌────┼────┐
 ▼    ▼    ▼
GPT  xAI  DeepSeek
 │    │    │
 └────┼────┘
      ▼
 AI Results
      ↓
 OPER 收斂
      ↓
 SQLite / Dashboard
      ↓
 人類最終決策

這才是你現在這套的正確定位

OPER = Context + Router + Permission + Queue + Audit + Decision Assembly

OpenAI / xAI / DeepSeek = 真正的推理執行者

而你截圖裡那些 GitHub 專案，就變成 OPER 可以透過 Registry 觀測、選擇與派工的實際工作資源，不是把 GitHub 本身當成 AI。

另外，我會保留一條硬邊界：OPER 可以自動派 read/analyze 任務；任何 Repo write 仍然走你現有的權限矩陣與人工核准。 這樣「自動化」和「越權修改」不會混在一起。https://github.com/Stormcar820/Lightning-Empire-AI-GTP4.1/new/main/frontend#閃電帝國AI-GTP4.1/前端/main.py
